title: चतुरशीतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bhishma burns like the sun and the Pandavas can hardly look at him, so Yudhishthira orders every army to attack him. Duryodhana and his brothers guard the grandsire, and Bhishma reminds Duryodhana of the folly of his greed.
summary.kn: ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಸೂರ್ಯನಂತೆ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಪಾಂಡವರಿಗೆ ಅವನನ್ನು ನೋಡಲೂ ಆಗದೆ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ತಮ್ಮಂದಿರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪಿತಾಮಹನನ್ನು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म सूर्य की तरह तपते हैं, पाण्डव उन्हें देख भी नहीं पाते, तब युधिष्ठिर सब सेनाओं को उन पर चढ़ने का आदेश देते हैं। दुर्योधन भाइयों सहित पितामह की रक्षा करता है।
summary.te: భీష్ముడు సూర్యునిలా తపిస్తాడు; పాండవులు అతన్ని చూడలేరు, కాబట్టి యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అన్ని సేనలను అతనిపై దాడి చేయమంటాడు. దుర్యోధనుడు సోదరులతో పితామహుని కాపాడతాడు.
summary.ta: பீஷ்மர் சூரியன் போல் எரிகிறார்; பாண்டவர் அவரைப் பார்க்கவும் இயலாததால் யுதிஷ்டிரர் எல்லாப் படைகளையும் அவர் மீது ஏவுகிறார். துரியோதனன் சகோதரருடன் பிதாமகரைக் காக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: സൂര്യനെപ്പോലെ ജ്വലിക്കുന്ന ഭീഷ്മരെ പാണ്ഡവർക്ക് നോക്കാൻപോലും കഴിയുന്നില്ല; അതിനാൽ എല്ലാ സേനകളോടും അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ആക്രമിക്കാൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ കൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു. ദുര്യോധനനും സഹോദരന്മാരും പിതാമഹനെ സംരക്ഷിക്കുന്നു; ദുര്യോധനന്റെ അത്യാഗ്രഹത്തിന്റെ മൂഢത ഭീഷ്മർ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഓർമിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.84; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
भीष्मं तु समरे क्रुद्धं प्रतपन्तं समन्ततः ।
न शेकुः पाण्डवा द्रष्टुं तपन्तमिव भास्करम् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas could not look at Bhishma, angered and scorching on every side in the battle, any more than at the blazing sun.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि धर्मपुत्रस्य शासनात् ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं मर्दयन्तं शितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, at the command of the son of Dharma, all the armies rushed at the son of Ganga as he crushed them with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
स तु भीष्मो रणश्लाघी सोमकान्सहसृञ्जयान् ।
पाञ्चालांश्च महेष्वासान्पातयामास सायकैः ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma, who delighted in battle, brought down the Somakas, the Srinjayas and the great bowmen of the Panchalas with his arrows.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमाना भीष्मेण पाञ्चालाः सोमकैः सह ।
भीष्ममेवाभ्ययुस्तूर्णं त्यक्त्वा मृत्युकृतं भयम् ॥

meaning.en: Slaughtered by Bhishma, the Panchalas with the Somakas set aside the fear of death and quickly went at Bhishma himself.

verses.text:
स तेषां रथिनां वीरो भीष्मः शांतनवो युधि ।
चिच्छेद सहसा राजन्बाहूनथ शिरांसि च ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma, son of Shantanu, that hero, suddenly cut off the arms and heads of those charioteers in the battle, O king.

verses.text:
विरथान्रथिनश्चक्रे पिता देवव्रतस्तव ।
पतितान्युत्तमाङ्गानि हयेभ्यो हयसादिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Your father Devavrata left charioteers without chariots, and the heads of cavalrymen fell from their horses.

verses.text:
निर्मनुष्यांश्च मातङ्गाञ्शयानान्पर्वतोपमान् ।
अपश्याम महाराज भीष्मास्त्रेण प्रमोहितान् ॥

meaning.en: We saw elephants, deprived of their riders, lying like mountains, stupefied by Bhishma's weapon, O great king.

verses.text:
न तत्रासीत्पुमान्कश्चित्पाण्डवानां विशां पते ।
अन्यत्र रथिनां श्रेष्ठाद्भीमसेनान्महाबलात् ॥

meaning.en: There was no man of the Pandavas standing there, lord of men, except the best of charioteers, mighty Bhimasena.

verses.text:
स हि भीष्मं समासाद्य ताडयामास संयुगे ।
ततो निष्टानको घोरो भीष्मभीमसमागमे ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Bhishma, he struck him in the battle. Then a terrible cry went up at that meeting of Bhishma and Bhima.

verses.text:
बभूव सर्वसैन्यानां घोररूपो भयानकः ।
तथैव पाण्डवा हृष्टाः सिंहनादमथानदन् ॥

meaning.en: It was frightful and dreadful among all the armies, and the Pandavas, rejoicing, roared like lions.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सोदर्यैः परिवारितः ।
भीष्मं जुगोप समरे वर्तमाने जनक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, surrounded by his brothers, protected Bhishma as the slaughter of men went on.

verses.text:
भीमस्तु सारथिं हत्वा भीष्मस्य रथिनां वरः ।
विद्रुताश्वे रथे तस्मिन्द्रवमाणे समन्ततः ।
सुनाभस्य शरेणाशु शिरश्चिच्छेद चारिहा ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, best of charioteers, killed Bhishma's charioteer. As that chariot ran about with its horses bolting in all directions, the killer of foes quickly cut off Sunabha's head with an arrow.

verses.text:
क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन स हतो न्यपतद्भुवि ।
हते तस्मिन्महाराज तव पुत्रे महारथे ।
नामृष्यन्त रणे शूराः सोदर्याः सप्त संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Struck by a very sharp razor-headed arrow, he fell to the ground. When that great chariot-warrior, your son, was killed, seven brave brothers of his could not bear it in the battle.

verses.text:
आदित्यकेतुर्बह्वाशी कुण्डधारो महोदरः ।
अपराजितः पण्डितको विशालाक्षः सुदुर्जयः ॥

meaning.en: Adityaketu, Bahvashi, Kundadhara, Mahodara, Aparajita, Panditaka and the hard-to-conquer Vishalaksha,

verses.text:
पाण्डवं चित्रसंनाहा विचित्रकवचध्वजाः ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे योद्धुकामारिमर्दनाः ॥

meaning.en: in bright armor with varied mail and banners, tormentors of foes eager to fight, rushed at the Pandava in the battle.

verses.text:
महोदरस्तु समरे भीमं विव्याध पत्रिभिः ।
नवभिर्वज्रसंकाशैर्नमुचिं वृत्रहा यथा ॥

meaning.en: Mahodara pierced Bhima in the battle with nine feathered arrows like thunderbolts, as the slayer of Vritra pierced Namuchi.

verses.text:
आदित्यकेतुः सप्तत्या बह्वाशी चापि पञ्चभिः ।
नवत्या कुण्डधारस्तु विशालाक्षश्च सप्तभिः ॥

meaning.en: Adityaketu struck him with seventy, and Bahvashi with five; Kundadhara with ninety, and Vishalaksha with seven.

verses.text:
अपराजितो महाराज पराजिष्णुर्महारथः ।
शरैर्बहुभिरानर्छद्भीमसेनं महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: Aparajita, O great king, a great chariot-warrior eager to beat him, struck mighty Bhimasena with many arrows.

verses.text:
रणे पण्डितकश्चैनं त्रिभिर्बाणैः समर्दयत् ।
स तन्न ममृषे भीमः शत्रुभिर्वधमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: And Panditaka tormented him with three arrows in the battle. Bhima, tormentor of foes, could not bear such an attack by enemies.

verses.text:
धनुः प्रपीड्य वामेन करेणामित्रकर्शनः ।
शिरश्चिच्छेद समरे शरेण नतपर्वणा ॥

meaning.en: Pressing his bow with his left hand, he cut off a head in the battle with a bent-jointed arrow.

verses.text:
अपराजितस्य सुनसं तव पुत्रस्य संयुगे ।
पराजितस्य भीमेन निपपात शिरो महीम् ॥

meaning.en: The head of your son Aparajita, with his fine nose, defeated by Bhima in the battle, fell to the ground.

verses.text:
अथापरेण भल्लेन कुण्डधारं महारथम् ।
प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: With another barbed arrow he sent the great chariot-warrior Kundadhara to the world of the dead as all the world watched.

verses.text:
ततः पुनरमेयात्मा प्रसंधाय शिलीमुखम् ।
प्रेषयामास समरे पण्डितं प्रति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then, O Bharata, that man of immeasurable spirit fitted another arrow and sent it at Panditaka in the battle.

verses.text:
स शरः पण्डितं हत्वा विवेश धरणीतलम् ।
यथा नरं निहत्याशु भुजगः कालचोदितः ॥

meaning.en: That arrow killed Panditaka and entered the earth, like a snake driven by fate that kills a man and quickly goes into the ground.

verses.text:
विशालाक्षशिरश्छित्त्वा पातयामास भूतले ।
त्रिभिः शरैरदीनात्मा स्मरन्क्लेशं पुरातनम् ॥

meaning.en: With three arrows, the undismayed Bhima, remembering the old affront, cut off Vishalaksha's head and brought it to the ground.

verses.text:
महोदरं महेष्वासं नाराचेन स्तनान्तरे ।
विव्याध समरे राजन्स हतो न्यपतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: In the battle, O king, he pierced the great bowman Mahodara in the chest with an iron arrow, and he fell dead to the ground.

verses.text:
आदित्यकेतोः केतुं च छित्त्वा बाणेन संयुगे ।
भल्लेन भृशतीक्ष्णेन शिरश्चिच्छेद चारिहा ॥

meaning.en: Having cut Adityaketu's banner with an arrow in the battle, the killer of foes cut off his head with a very sharp barbed arrow.

verses.text:
बह्वाशिनं ततो भीमः शरेण नतपर्वणा ।
प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो यमस्य सदनं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima, enraged, sent Bahvashi to Yama's abode with a bent-jointed arrow.

verses.text:
प्रदुद्रुवुस्ततस्तेऽन्ये पुत्रास्तव विशां पते ।
मन्यमाना हि तत्सत्यं सभायां तस्य भाषितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then your other sons, O lord of men, fled, thinking that what he had said in the assembly was true.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितः ।
अब्रवीत्तावकान्योधान्भीमोऽयं युधि वध्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, wasted with grief for his brothers, said to your warriors, "Let this Bhima be killed in the battle."

verses.text:
एवमेते महेष्वासाः पुत्रास्तव विशां पते ।
भ्रातॄन्संदृश्य निहतान्प्रास्मरंस्ते हि तद्वचः ॥

meaning.en: Thus these great bowmen, your sons, O lord of men, seeing their brothers killed, remembered those words.

verses.text:
यदुक्तवान्महाप्राज्ञः क्षत्ता हितमनामयम् ।
तदिदं समनुप्राप्तं वचनं दिव्यदर्शिनः ॥

meaning.en: The words that the very wise Kshatta, Vidura, spoke for your good and welfare, the words of one who sees beyond the ordinary, have now come true.

verses.text:
लोभमोहसमाविष्टः पुत्रप्रीत्या जनाधिप ।
न बुध्यसे पुरा यत्तत्तथ्यमुक्तं वचो महत् ॥

meaning.en: Seized with greed and delusion, and from love for your son, O lord of men, you did not understand then the great and true words that were spoken.

verses.text:
तथैव हि वधार्थाय पुत्राणां पाण्डवो बली ।
नूनं जातो महाबाहुर्यथा हन्ति स्म कौरवान् ॥

meaning.en: Surely the strong, long-armed Pandava was born for the killing of your sons, since he kills the Kauravas in this way.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भीष्ममासाद्य मारिष ।
दुःखेन महताविष्टो विललापातिकर्शितः ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, O revered one, came to Bhishma, overcome with great grief, greatly wasted, and lamented.

verses.text:
निहता भ्रातरः शूरा भीमसेनेन मे युधि ।
यतमानास्तथान्येऽपि हन्यन्ते सर्वसैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: My brave brothers have been killed by Bhimasena in the battle, and all the other soldiers, though they strive, are being killed.

verses.text:
भवांश्च मध्यस्थतया नित्यमस्मानुपेक्षते ।
सोऽहं कापथमारूढः पश्य दैवमिदं मम ॥

meaning.en: And you, taking a neutral stance, always overlook us. See my fate, set as I am on a wrong road.

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचः क्रूरं पिता देवव्रतस्तव ।
दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत्साश्रुलोचनम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing those cruel words, your father Devavrata spoke to Duryodhana, whose eyes were filled with tears.

verses.text:
उक्तमेतन्मया पूर्वं द्रोणेन विदुरेण च ।
गान्धार्या च यशस्विन्या तत्त्वं तात न बुद्धवान् ॥

meaning.en: I told you this before, and so did Drona, Vidura and the renowned Gandhari, dear one, but you did not take in the truth.

verses.text:
समयश्च मया पूर्वं कृतो वः शत्रुकर्शन ।
नाहं युधि विमोक्तव्यो नाप्याचार्यः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: And, tormentor of foes, I made an agreement with you before, that neither I nor the teacher should ever be spared from the fighting.

verses.text:
यं यं हि धार्तराष्ट्राणां भीमो द्रक्ष्यति संयुगे ।
हनिष्यति रणे तं तं सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: Whichever of Dhritarashtra's sons Bhima sees in the battle, he will kill him in the fight. I tell you this truly.

verses.text:
स त्वं राजन्स्थिरो भूत्वा दृढां कृत्वा रणे मतिम् ।
योधयस्व रणे पार्थान्स्वर्गं कृत्वा परायणम् ॥

meaning.en: So, O king, be steady, make your mind firm in battle, and fight the sons of Pritha in the battle, making heaven your goal.

verses.text:
न शक्याः पाण्डवा जेतुं सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः ।
तस्माद्युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा स्थिरां युध्यस्व भारत ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas cannot be conquered even by gods and demons with Indra. So set your mind on the fight and fight steadily, O Bharata.
